title: Responsive interface, PWA identity and native provider-capacity review evidence
notice: Historical reviews of explicit source and screenshot snapshots, followed by code verification and corrective changes. This artifact is evidence of local checks, not a security certification, WCAG certification, production approval, or proof of a real subscriber quota. Raw prompts and responses remain private; this public record omits operator paths, topology, costs, account/API/session identifiers and credentials.

limitations: No real subscriber account was queried. Numerical quota scenarios use synthetic native protocol events; a genuine installed Codex 0.157.0 runtime was separately exercised with an isolated unauthenticated account and local test provider.
Claude displays only genuinely reported SDK fields; absent percentages, windows and resets remain unknown. API-key authentication does not invent subscription capacity.
Reports belong to project sessions. Provider accounts are neither correlated nor added across sessions; a report may originate from another team member.
Responsive Chromium screenshots, computed contrast samples and accessibility-tree checks are not a physical iOS/Safari/Android test or a complete WCAG audit.
Current web/PWA branding and responsive controls are in scope; inherited native application artwork was not redesigned.
